# sonarqube_permissions (Resource)

The complete set of permissions of one user or group, globally, on a project, or in a permission template. Permissions the principal has in that scope but that are not listed are removed. Import ID: `principal` (global) or `principal:p_<project>`, `principal:t_<template id>`, `principal:tn_<template name>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A global permission for a group.
resource "sonarqube_permissions" "ci_scan" {
  group_name  = "ci"
  permissions = ["scan"]
}

# Project permissions for a user.
resource "sonarqube_permissions" "alice_api" {
  login_name  = "alice"
  project_key = "example-api"
  permissions = ["admin", "issueadmin"]
}

# The creator of each project gets admin, through a template.
resource "sonarqube_permission_template" "projects" {
  name = "projects"
}

resource "sonarqube_permissions" "creator" {
  special_group_name = "project_creator"
  template_name      = sonarqube_permission_template.projects.name
  permissions        = ["admin"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `permissions` (Set of String) Permissions, validated by the server since they vary by version and edition. Global: `admin`, `gateadmin`, `profileadmin`, `provisioning`, `scan`, `applicationcreator`, `portfoliocreator`. Project and template: `admin`, `codeviewer`, `issueadmin`, `securityhotspotadmin`, `scan`, `user`.

### Optional

- `group_name` (String) Group name, or `anyone`.
- `login_name` (String) User login.
- `project_key` (String) Project scope.
- `special_group_name` (String) `project_creator`: the creator of a project, in a permission template.
- `template_id` (String) Permission template scope, by ID.
- `template_name` (String) Permission template scope, by name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this resource in Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_permissions.example 'alice:p_example-api'
```
